_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. Reconciled on 2026-11-02 to the measured merged tree: the in-flight media/file/persona node packs and the journal broker-sync work grew `routers`, `eclipse_memory`, `skills`, `code` and the harness root. These ceilings are measured, not padded; the split remains with the streams that grew them.
